description:
[Game reference] Explosive splash radius, fire and siege damage vs every building grade. For every explosive, explosive ammo, fire source and siege weapon: `damage` by type, `radius_m` (full damage
inside `min_radius_m`, falling off in a straight line to nothing at `radius_m` - see `falloff`), `fire`, and
`per_target` - damage and hits to destroy each building grade and door (`twigs`, `wood`, `stone`, `metal`,
`toptier`, `door.hinged.*`, garage door), from outside; `hits_inside` / `damage_inside` where a wall's soft (inside)
side needs a different count. `fire_rules` says which grades burn (stone and up never do). From the
server files; the data on rust.wiki/raid/splash-and-fire. For the cheapest way to raid a base use the raid
calculator (`/calculators/raid/compute`). Explosion radius and damage per building grade/door; fire never hurts stone or better.

item.description: Only one explosive, ammo or weapon, by shortname or name.
